lessons.culture: Friends often argue affectionately over who pays, and haadi 3liya (this one is on me) is the usual line, so expect a round of polite refusal. challenge.title: At the Restaurant
challenge.instructions: Have a full conversation ordering a drink and a meal at a Casablanca restaurant, then ask for and settle the bill.

Order at least one drink and one dish, including one preference (e.g. no onion, extra bread, sweet or no sugar)
Ask for the bill and how much it costs
Say something to close the meal, like a compliment to the food or a thank you
